isolationMetadata: Same single metadata SELECT reads only current DB sys.databases snapshot_isolation_state integer0..3 and is_read_committed_snapshot_on boolean. Missing/invalid types fail closed. No settings ALTER, new batch or app read-policy change.
verifiedConfigReconstruction: Initial proc DB5 takes priority. Missing fields require exact canonical cwd, valid unchanged PM2 start/PID and same installed @next/env production precedence. Explicit initial NODE_ENV must equal production. Only truly absent NODE_ENV may use proven exact canonical Next CLI realpath, exact start args (optional validated port) and known proc next-server title to establish documented default production. Explicit empty/false/development/test or unproven entry refuses. All actual Next env files must predate app start, and pre/post existence/stat/hash/cwd must remain identical. Diagnostic process RAM only, restore its environment; failed proof CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE with fixed reason, no guessed fallback. Config source/proof are fixed enums, raw args/title never output.
recoveryJournal: Before identity attempt, independently summarize only fixed attempts.jsonl bounded tail4MiB. Pair IDs internally; output fixed UTC windows, year/week, allowlisted status/code and counts only, max20. Never expose IDs/owner/raw lines/paths. Partial pairs/tail coverage cannot establish absence. No history SQL or financial read.

actions.name: READ_DATABASE_IDENTITY
actions.sideEffect: Manual diagnostics only. Exact one online nenova-erp PID; DB5 initial proc environ fields RAM-only, no local/other-app or guessed fallback. Missing mandatory fields require verifiedConfigReconstruction, otherwise CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE. Fresh owned mssqlpool max1/connect15s/query10s/one fixed metadata SELECT/close finally, stable PID readback. SQL returns only server+DB SHA256 and bounded schema counts; raw names/credentials/env/jlist/config/errors never output/saved/backed up. Registered diagnose_performance_only packaging reuses SSH and production concurrency; deploy job/push/conditions unchanged. No operational DB writes, app changes, restart, PM2 persistence, financial read, new endpoint or environment flag.
